meta.title: CraftLink — Pro tradesperson page in 2 min | Instagram, Facebook & WhatsApp leads
meta.description: Create a professional page with one link: voice capture funnel, transcription, lead scoring, and WhatsApp handoff. Built for tradespeople who don’t have a full website — electricians, plumbers, joiners, HVAC, and construction trades.

typingTitle.intro: One link to centralise every client request from

hero.asideShowcaseAlt: From an Instagram bio to a CraftLink page: a tradesperson profile turned into a pro storefront with quote and service buttons.
hero.lead: Turn followers into qualified quote requests. End the chaos across DMs and email: one link on your social profiles and Google listing lets prospects send a voice or written brief. Our AI shapes the information and delivers a structured dossier straight to the messenger you already use.

preview.title: Your tradesperson profile, ready to share
preview.about: Fast call-outs and clear quotes. Describe the issue (written or voice): I’ll call you back with an honest range and the right questions.

flow.figureAlt: Four-step diagram: all sources, central link (voice or text), AI processing and files, then field action (WhatsApp, SMS, jobsite).
